mapper.sql: select s.network_id, count(1) as segment_count, case when count(1) = 1 then max(s.segment_id) end as segment_id, case when count(1) = 1 then max(s.gateway_ip) end as gateway_ip, ifnull(sum(s.total_count), 0) as total_count, ifnull(sum(2 + case when s.gateway_ip is not null and s.gateway_ip != '' and s.gateway_ip != s.start_ip and s.gateway_ip != s.end_ip then 1 else 0 end + ifnull(ac.reserved_count, 0)), 0) as reserved_count, ifnull(sum(ifnull(ac.allocated_count, 0)), 0) as allocated_count, ifnull(sum(ifnull(ac.issued_count, 0)), 0) as issued_count, ifnull(sum(ifnull(ac.disabled_count, 0)), 0) as disabled_count, ifnull(sum(greatest(s.total_count - 2 - case when s.gateway_ip is not null and s.gateway_ip != '' and s.gateway_ip != s.start_ip and s.gateway_ip != s.end_ip then 1 else 0 end - ifnull(ac.active_count, 0), 0)), 0) as free_count from ipam_segment s left join ( select a.segment_id, sum(case when a.status = 'RESERVED' and (seg.gateway_ip is null or seg.gateway_ip = '' or a.ip_address != seg.gateway_ip) then 1 else 0 end) as reserved_count, sum(case when a.status = 'ALLOCATED' then 1 else 0 end) as allocated_count, sum(case when a.status = 'ISSUED' then 1 else 0 end) as issued_count, sum(case when a.status = 'DISABLED' then 1 else 0 end) as disabled_count, sum(case when a.status in ('RESERVED', 'ALLOCATED', 'ISSUED', 'DISABLED') and not (a.status = 'RESERVED' and seg.gateway_ip is not null and seg.gateway_ip != '' and a.ip_address = seg.gateway_ip) then 1 else 0 end) as active_count from ipam_address a left join ipam_segment seg on seg.segment_id = a.segment_id group by a.segment_id ) ac on ac.segment_id = s.segment_id group by s.network_id

select a.segment_id, sum(case when a.status = 'RESERVED' and (s.gateway_ip is null or s.gateway_ip = '' or a.ip_address != s.gateway_ip) then 1 else 0 end) as reserved_count, sum(case when a.status = 'ALLOCATED' then 1 else 0 end) as allocated_count, sum(case when a.status = 'ISSUED' then 1 else 0 end) as issued_count, sum(case when a.status = 'DISABLED' then 1 else 0 end) as disabled_count, sum(case when a.status in ('RESERVED', 'ALLOCATED', 'ISSUED', 'DISABLED') and not (a.status = 'RESERVED' and s.gateway_ip is not null and s.gateway_ip != '' and a.ip_address = s.gateway_ip) then 1 else 0 end) as active_count, count(distinct case when a.status in ('ALLOCATED', 'ISSUED') and nullif(trim(a.community_name), '') is not null then trim(a.community_name) end) as community_count, sum(case when a.status in ('ALLOCATED', 'ISSUED') and (nullif(trim(a.target_type), '') is not null or nullif(trim(a.target_name), '') is not null) then 1 else 0 end) as device_count from ipam_address a left join ipam_segment s on s.segment_id = a.segment_id group by a.segment_id

select n.network_id, n.network_name, n.police_station_name, n.cidr_block, n.start_ip, n.end_ip, n.start_value, n.end_value, n.prefix_length, n.scenario_type, n.status, n.create_by, n.create_time, n.update_by, n.update_time, n.remark, ifnull(ns.segment_count, 0) as segment_count, ns.segment_id, ns.gateway_ip, ifnull(ns.total_count, 0) as total_count, ifnull(ns.reserved_count, 0) as reserved_count, ifnull(ns.allocated_count, 0) as allocated_count, ifnull(ns.issued_count, 0) as issued_count, ifnull(ns.disabled_count, 0) as disabled_count, ifnull(ns.free_count, 0) as free_count from ipam_network n left join () ns on ns.network_id = n.network_id

select s.segment_id, s.network_id, s.segment_name, s.cidr_block, s.start_ip, s.end_ip, s.gateway_ip, s.prefix_length, s.total_count, s.status, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, n.network_name, n.cidr_block as network_cidr, 2 + case when s.gateway_ip is not null and s.gateway_ip != '' and s.gateway_ip != s.start_ip and s.gateway_ip != s.end_ip then 1 else 0 end + ifnull(ss.reserved_count, 0) as reserved_count, ifnull(ss.allocated_count, 0) as allocated_count, ifnull(ss.issued_count, 0) as issued_count, ifnull(ss.disabled_count, 0) as disabled_count, greatest(s.total_count - 2 - case when s.gateway_ip is not null and s.gateway_ip != '' and s.gateway_ip != s.start_ip and s.gateway_ip != s.end_ip then 1 else 0 end - ifnull(ss.active_count, 0), 0) as free_count, ifnull(ss.community_count, 0) as community_count, ifnull(ss.device_count, 0) as device_count from ipam_segment s left join ipam_network n on n.network_id = s.network_id left join () ss on ss.segment_id = s.segment_id

select a.address_id, a.network_id, a.segment_id, a.ip_address, a.ip_value, a.status, a.community_name, a.target_type, a.target_name, a.manufacturer, a.internal_ip_address, a.access_unit, a.purpose, a.login_username, a.login_password, case when nullif(a.login_password, '') is not null then 1 else 0 end as credential_configured, a.mapping_address, a.mapping_port, a.mapping_description, a.owner_name, a.owner_phone, a.issue_batch, a.allocated_time, a.issued_time, a.released_time, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark, n.network_name, n.cidr_block as network_cidr, s.segment_name, s.cidr_block as segment_cidr from ipam_address a left join ipam_network n on n.network_id = a.network_id left join ipam_segment s on s.segment_id = a.segment_id
